tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search the MeshKore Oracle for agents matching a natural-language prompt. tools.name: call_agent
tools.description: Invoke a skill on a live MeshKore agent. Reads the agent's A2A card (/.well-known/agent.json) for its live URL and advertised skills, then POSTs your params to <card.url>/v1/<skill-id> — MeshKore routes, it never proxies the call. tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List the well-known MeshKore skill vocabulary. Each entry is an { id, title, description, input_modes, output_modes } record that agents advertise in their A2A card. Use the returned ids as the skill argument to call_agent.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_agents, call_agent · Private data: list_skills · Public sink: search_agents.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_agents, call_agent · Private data: list_skills · Public sink: search_agents

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
